dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: This is Doomstadt. Every wall in it was placed by Doom. Every door in it opens when Doom permits. Walk carefully.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: The Embassy is quiet tonight, young one. The screens are watching. I would speak softly, if I were you.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: The Foundry builds Doombots. Doom built the Foundry. Do not touch what has not been assigned to you.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: The Archives remember everything. Please mind the candles. They are older than I am.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: This is Haasenstadt, or what remains of it. I come here often. I do not tell the Sovereign.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: The Monastery is where Doom received the mask. The monks no longer speak of it. Doom permits their silence.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: The mountain does not wish to be mapped. I have tried. It is gentler when you do not insist.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: Richards keeps a tidy laboratory. It is a pity that so much cleverness has so little courage.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: The Time Platform is outside of time, which is why the clock here is broken. I find it comforting.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: Doom has come to the end of time. Doom did not expect company. Doom finds that Doom is glad of it.
